text:
CostBot: [ALERT] account ORB-19 (Orbiton) showing 3.1x token run-rate vs forecast in last 24h. Top signal: embeddings-heavy traffic from a new release. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/accts/ORB-19/spend :eyes:
Maya S (CSM): Noted. Orbiton shipped the search-relevance feature Friday, they mentioned thresholds but not expected this surge. I've got a 1:1 with their AM later today.
Ethan R (Success Eng): I'll pull the token-by-route breakdown now. Probable causes: missing prefix caching & aggressive embedding window. Quick query I'm running:```sql
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tokens24h FROM usage WHERE account='ORB-19' AND ts > now()-24h GROUP BY route ORDER BY tokens24h DESC;
```
Sam L (Solutions): If it's embeddings, we can suggest a per-request sample-rate + client-side caching. Also can recommend quantized model variant for embed-heavy loads (rn50-q4).
Priya K (AE): Renewal check — Orbiton is at month 9, renewal QBR in 3 weeks. This spike could change conversation if we don't show mitigation options. We should prepare cost-saver suggestions and a runway forecast.
Maya S (CSM): Action list: 1) Ethan to post route breakdown + peak timestamps (ETA 20m). 2) Sam to draft a 1-slide cost-saver recommendation (caching + lower-cost embed model + token caps). 3) Priya to prep a brief renewal note and confirm QBR agenda. I'll capture feedback from AM and surface any product asks. :thumbsup:
Ethan R (Success Eng): Breakdown: embedding/search.index calls = 72% of tokens; user-chat = 18%; misc = 10%. Peak window 14:30-16:10 UTC. Attaching quick excerpt:```json
{"route":"search.index","tokens_24h":452310,"peak_minute":1420}
```
Maya S (CSM): Good detail — can you add median sequence length for those embedding calls? If they're sending long contexts we can recommend truncation.
Ethan R (Success Eng): Median seq len for search.index = 768 tokens. That plus 80k requests explains the burn. Suggest temp throttle to 60rps or enabling prefix KV caching.
Sam L (Solutions): I'll put together an executable snippet we can send the customer to flip on caching and switch to the q4 embed model. Example client diff:
```diff
- model: emb-large
+ model: emb-large-q4
+ enable_prefix_cache: true
+ max_seq_len: 256
```
Maya S (CSM): Perfect. Also noting Orbiton asked for better cost visibility. We should include a one-click dashboard link and proposed monthly spend forecast under three scenarios (baseline, ramp, surge) for the QBR.
Priya K (AE): I'll draft the forecast slide using Ethan's numbers. Proposed QBR ask: offer a short-term burst credit + joint plan to move to cached/quantized paths — present as proactive enablement not a concession.
CostBot: NOTE: temporary alert suppression requested by Maya S for ORB-19 until 1971234660.
Maya S (CSM): I'll call the AM at 17:00 PT and confirm acceptance of the playbook. If they want immediate mitigation, Sam — can you standby for a quick patch?
Sam L (Solutions): Yep, on standby. I'll also prepare a short runbook (two-step) we can paste into the support ticket.
Maya S (CSM): Great. I'll update the QBR deck draft and send a pre-read to Priya and Ethan by EOD. Anyone else need to be looped in?
Priya K (AE): Product feedback team? If this becomes a repeat pattern we need a builtin throttle suggestion in the Console. I'll ping PM.
Ethan R (Success Eng): Posting final numbers to the ticket now.
Maya S (CSM): Thanks team — capturing as thread action items. We'll reconvene after my AM call and before I send the pre-read. :calendar:
